name: 195. Decision emulation is opt-in (decision-emulation-opt-in)
description: Pins compat's convert_decision_to_responses (off by default). A model with no native decisions endpoint (openai/gpt-4o-mini) is rejected with unsupported_operation (HTTP 400) and a message naming the setting unless the request opts in with x-bf-compat: ["convert_decision_to_responses"]; opted in, it is emulated through the model's Responses API and extra_fields.converted_request_type reads responses. Both on /v1/decisions and the OpenAI-compatible /openai/v1/decisions. A native decisions model (openai/gpt-6-luna) answers without the opt-in, and a rejected chat primary still falls back to it. Opted in, it is still answered natively: compat checks the model catalog and marks only models that are not native decisions models, so no conversion is reported. The default-off cases strip x-bf-compat in a prerequest so a COMPAT=on run, which injects x-bf-compat: true, still pins the default.
